description: This file defines a utility function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'. It processes various data structures, normalizes currency strings, applies optional filters, and merges results to produce a summarized report of agent usage and costs.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: Converts currency-like strings or other values to a safe number, handling nulls, undefined, and non-numeric strings.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Main function that queries MongoDB collections, processes data, and returns aggregated agent usage and cost information with filtering and pagination.
